meta.source_of_truth: Official operator documents only (Venetian structure sheets 1-37 + DSE IV schedule page; Wynn daily structures/poster PDFs; Wynn WPT schedule + structures PDFs). Every row links its sources with excerpts and retrieval dates.
meta.single_entry_rule: A row is single_entry_confirmed=true ONLY if an official document explicitly states no re-entry / one entry / freezeout. No such statement exists for any Venetian event (sheets 1-37) or any WPT event read (structures chunks 0-3). Wynn daily events officially ALLOW re-entry/add-ons. The 'single-entry / freezeout confirmed' filter therefore currently returns zero rows — displayed honestly rather than filled by inference.
meta.ranking_rule: Rows are ranked by guarantee_per_buyin only when both guarantee (prize-pool basis) and buy-in are officially printed. guaranteed pool / entry fee is a descriptive ratio, not a forecast of value. Bounty events, satellites, team events and high rollers are labeled and kept in their own sections.
meta.finish_times: No official document publishes estimated finish times. Overlap analysis uses start times + late-registration cutoffs + structure length only, and is labeled 'possible overlap', never 'confirmed impossible'.
meta.coverage_note: WPT structures PDF chunks 0-3 of 8 were read line-by-line; chunks 4-7 (some December events) are linked but their re-entry rules are marked unverified. See Flagged for Review.
